_doc: HAIRLINE recorded SFX: sources (downloaded by scripts/assets/sfx.sh into .cache/sfx/dl/<source>/) and recipes (built by scripts/sfx/build.py into public/assets/sfx/<name>.ogg). Times are seconds in the source file. Categories set the loudness target and the Opus bitrate (see 'categories'). Every recipe also carries its catalogue fields (what, ch, replaces, bus) for docs/assets/sfx.md.

amb_far.desc: distant layer, under another bed (stereo loop)

radio.desc: radio noise bed driven by gameplay (mono loop)

event.desc: multi-second event (a pass, a kettle; stereo or mono)

foley_soft.desc: quiet foley one-shot (paper, pencil, clicks), mono

tick.desc: short sharp transient (steps, knocks, clicks), mono

event_peaky.desc: multi-second event made of transients (footsteps passing)

recipes.name: hammer_floor
recipes.what: Odile's hammer blow heard through the floor: muffled wood knock with a low body thump and a short dark room tail
recipes.ch: Ch1 flat: hammering from downstairs (3-blow bursts, last burst through the fade)
recipes.bus: bus, volume 0.8 (+-1.5 dB per blow); irregular 3-blow bursts (see Integration); lowpass 850 Hz at runtime (near-transparent, the files are pre-filtered), no extra room (the small-room tail is baked); random variant per blow, never the same twice, +-4% playbackRate; pair with the cam.shake

recipes.name: hammer_near
recipes.what: Dry close hammer on a nail into a floorboard, with hammer ring
recipes.ch: Spare: Ch4/Ch5 workshop (Odile at the bench), Ch5 nail above the bench

recipes.name: amb_rain_window
recipes.what: Rain against a window from inside, water dripping off the roof
recipes.ch: Ch1 flat (the whole chapter); Ch4 Day 5 low-passed under the workshop
recipes.replaces: audio/rain.ogg inside the flat (keep rain.ogg for exteriors)

recipes.name: amb_fridge_hum
recipes.what: Refrigerator compressor hum (mono point source)
recipes.ch: Ch1 flat: kitchenette fridge (X-ray hotspot is taped to it)
recipes.bus: bus, volume 0.12-0.2, positional (PannerNode at the fridge) or distance gain

recipes.name: fluoro_hum
recipes.what: Fluorescent strip-light hum with ballast buzz
recipes.ch: Ch1 failing tube over the kitchenette; Ch2 doorway tube; Ch4 bench tube (Day 5 flicker, fixed by Week 7)
recipes.replaces: the 120 Hz noise/sawtooth/square buzz in scene1.js, scene2.js, scene4/lights.js (keep the tick on re-strike)
recipes.bus: bus, volume 0.08-0.15; gate the gain with the tube's on/off so the flicker cuts the hum; distance gain in Ch2

recipes.name: tv_race_bed
recipes.what: Roadside Tour de France crowd, passing cars and cycles, with a TV helicopter under it
recipes.ch: Ch1 TV (cycling broadcast) until it is switched off
recipes.bus: bus, volume 0.3; bandpass 250-4500 Hz + slight saturation for a CRT speaker; cut on tvOff (pair with a CRT click, see generate list)

recipes.name: door_flat_open

recipes.name: door_flat_close

recipes.ch: Ch1 end (under the fade), spare

recipes.name: mug_clink

recipes.name: step_wood

recipes.name: body_thud
recipes.what: Soft heavy body impact

recipes.replaces: audio.thud() (keep the sine as a fallback)
recipes.bus: fx, volume 0.25 under a step, lowpass 900 Hz

recipes.name: club_pass

recipes.ch: Ch2 z < -24 run club passes; Ch5 run club beat

recipes.name: scaffold_creak

recipes.bus: fx, volume 0.4; lowpass 3 kHz; for the tape bow use playbackRate 1.6, volume 0.12
